title: Let ScanFinder auto-file the easy ones
description: Turn on auto-filing so clean documents skip Review, set the confidence threshold, and explain per-sender graduation (a new sender proves itself with a few clean confirmations before its documents file themselves). Settings -> Processing.

steps.narration: ScanFinder can file the documents it's sure about by itself, and only ask you about the rest. Here's how to switch that on.
steps.caption: Auto-file the easy ones

steps.narration: Open Settings from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Open Settings

steps.narration: This switch lets ScanFinder file a document without showing it to you — but only when it read perfectly cleanly.
steps.caption: The auto-file switch

steps.narration: This slider is how sure it has to be. At a hundred percent only flawless reads file themselves; lower it and it'll file a few more.
steps.caption: How sure it must be

steps.narration: Drag it down to somewhere you trust — say, around ninety.
steps.caption: 4. Set the threshold

steps.narration: The number here always shows the level you've chosen, at a glance.
steps.caption: The level, at a glance

steps.narration: And it's careful with new senders. A sender you've never confirmed won't auto-file at all until you've confirmed a few of its documents cleanly — so it earns your trust first.
steps.caption: New senders earn trust first

steps.narration: Set it once, and your quiet days get a lot quieter. Next: Learning Repair.
steps.caption: Next: Learning Repair
